traits.name: Enhanced Senses
traits.description: The whitespine gains an advantage on non-attack tests that rely on smell.

traits.name: Spined Carapace
traits.description: After an enemy within 5 feet of the whitespine grazes them with a weapon attack, that enemy takes 3 (1d6) keen damage.

actions.name: Pheromone Release
actions.description: The whitespine releases foul pheromones. Each non-whitespine character within 10 feet of them must succeed on a DC 15 Discipline test or become Stunned until the end of the whitespine's next turn.

strikes.name: Claws
strikes.on-hit: and the whitespine can spend 1 focus to make the target Afflicted [1d4 vital] until the target regains at least 1 health.
strikes.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 7) keen damage, and the whitespine can spend 1 focus to make the target Afflicted [1d4 vital] until the target regains at least 1 health.

strikes.name: Goring Tusks
strikes.on-hit: If the whitespine hits with this attack immediately after moving at least 15 feet, the target takes an extra 5 (1d10) impact damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Athletics test or be knocked Prone.
strikes.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 5 (1d10) impact damage. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) impact damage.
